# Tool map
<!-- Generated by /brain-setup. Until then, Claude discovers tools by their descriptions. -->
Not generated yet: run `/brain-setup`.

Known tool names of the storage-mcp-servers builds:
- powermax: list_unispheres, list_arrays, get_array, get_array_health, list_srps, list_storage_groups,
  get_storage_group, get_volume, find_volume_by_wwn, list_hosts, get_host, find_wwpn, list_masking_views,
  get_masking_view, get_port_group, list_directors, get_port, get_replication,
  get_alert_summary, get_alerts, get_audit_log, list_performance_categories,
  list_performance_metrics, list_performance_keys, get_performance, get_performance_overview, unisphere_get
- mds: list_switches, run_show, flogi_summary, trace_wwpn, zone_check, port_channel_health,
  scan_port_errors, slow_drain_check, show_logging_onboard, get_log_events, show_flogi_database*, show_fcns_database*,
  show_zoneset_active*, show_device_alias_*, show_interface_*, show_port_channel_summary, show_logging,
  show_accounting_log
- ucsc: list_centrals, list_domains, list_fabric_interconnects, list_servers, get_server,
  list_service_profiles, get_service_profile, get_service_profile_vhbas, find_wwpn, list_wwn_pools,
  list_vsans, list_fc_uplinks, list_fc_port_channels, get_fc_port_errors, get_vhba_pinning,
  trace_service_profile_san, get_domain_fc_health, list_faults, get_events, get_audit_log, query_class, get_object
- kuparashit (vCenter snapshots, not live; `esx` pwwns/luns/cluster/fi, `vms` hostname/datastore/naas,
  `ds` naa/size/cluster = DATASTORE cluster): `overview` once (snapshot time), `locate` for any identifier,
  then `related` / `luns` / `diff`; `sql` only for joins. Ask for `fields=[...]`. Unused = by VMware only.
- ontap, harvest: NetApp's official MCP servers (the ONTAP one also has write tools: the hook blocks them).
  Their tools, and Aria's, are discovered by their descriptions until `/brain-setup` records them here.
- docs-search / docs-local: see the docs-lookup skill.
- Not tools: daily_health_check, capacity_report, srdf_health, what_changed, troubleshoot_host_latency (powermax),
  fabric_health_check, check_host_connectivity, investigate_slow_drain, port_history (mds), ucs_health_check,
  troubleshoot_server, trace_san_path, domain_san_health (ucsc) are MCP prompts (/ recipes for the person); call
  the tools they name instead.
